newsitem.title: GERMANY: Heidelberger Druck to work with Kodak.
newsitem.headline: Heidelberger Druck to work with Kodak.

text.p: German printing systems maker Heidelberger Druckmaschinen AG on Tuesday confirmed it planned to cooperate with Eastman Kodak Co in the area of prepress technology.
The Wall Street Journal on Tuesday in its electronic edition said the two companies would develop new products together and combine marketing and distribution operations.
A spokesman for Heidelberger Druck on Tuesday confirmed the companies would develop and market some prepress products together.
Both companies were repositioning their products as more and more computer technology moves into the printing process.
He did not reveal the volume of repress business the two companies have together.
